blocks.text: DALLAS, Texas — Rapper Yella Beezy was found guilty on Wednesday, Nov. 11, of hiring the gunman who fatally shot rapper MO3 in a brazen daylight attack on a busy Dallas interstate in 2020. Yella Beezy, 35, whose real name is Markies Conway, was unanimously convicted of capital murder by a Dallas County jury in the death of MO3, whose real name was Melvin Noble. He was sentenced to life in prison without the possibility of parole. In September, a jury found Kewon White guilty of capital murder for fatally shooting Noble.
